extraFacts.fact: Wave 4 products are API certified and supplied with the API monogram by API-licensed manufacturers to the applicable specification: API 6A, API 16A, API 16C, API 16D or API 7K.

faqs.q: What is a trailer-mounted frac data van used for?
faqs.a: A frac data van is the control and monitoring centre of a fracturing fleet. This one is a custom trailer with HVAC, insulated flooring, operator desks, a pantry and storage, and a multi-screen wall showing all fleet parameters with recording and playback for post-job analysis.

faqs.q: What mounting options does the trailer-mounted frac data van offer?
faqs.a: It is engineered as a custom trailer, and is also available as a modified seafreight container or a truck-mounted box. State the transport and site needs on the RFQ.

faqs.q: What does the trailer-mounted frac data van connect to?
faqs.a: A full I/O network connects by wire or wifi to all fleet units: blender or blenders, LAS, hydration unit, transfer pumps and pumpers. The operator controls the entire fleet from a single station.

faqs.q: What does the operator cabin of the trailer-mounted frac data van include?
faqs.a: It has HVAC, insulated flooring, operator desks, a pantry and storage. The multi-screen visualisation wall records and plays back the fleet parameters for post-job analysis.

faqs.q: What certifications and climate options does the trailer-mounted frac data van have?
faqs.a: CE and GOST certifications and arctic and desert environmental envelopes are available. State the approvals and ambient range on the RFQ.

faqs.q: Which frac units can the trailer-mounted frac data van control?
faqs.a: It can connect to the [frac blender](/p/frac-blender-mfr-50-50-bbl-min-auto-density-control-chemical-additive-system), the [LAS](/p/frac-las-8-tank-ss316-tote-tanks-mass-flowmeters-trailer-mounted), the [hydration unit](/p/frac-hydration-unit-200-bbl-12-12-centrifugal-90-bbl-min-ss316-tote-tanks), the [transfer pumps](/p/frac-transfer-pump-centrifugal-12-12-300-hp-diesel-hydraulic-drive-skid-mounted) and the [frac pumpers](/p/frac-pumper-2-500-hp-trailer-mounted-fleet-networked-dnv-optional). Each unit needs a matching data interface.

faqs.q: How does the trailer-mounted frac data van differ from a unit with its own control cabin?
faqs.a: A unit with its own cabin controls only itself, while the data van gives one operator control of the whole fleet through a single station. Standalone control remains possible on each unit.

faqs.q: Where is the trailer-mounted frac data van used?
faqs.a: It is used on hydraulic fracturing fleets to coordinate equipment and to record job data. See the guide on [frac and stimulation equipment](/blog/frac-and-stimulation-equipment).

faqs.q: What should I send for a frac data van quotation?
faqs.a: Send the list of fleet units to connect, the screen and recording requirements, the mounting type, the certification needed and the ambient range. The van is built to your specification.

faqs.q: Can the trailer-mounted frac data van be supplied as a container or truck box?
faqs.a: Yes. It is engineered as a custom trailer and also available as a modified seafreight container or a truck-mounted box, with the same HVAC, desks, pantry and multi-screen wall in each. State the transport and the site limits on the RFQ.

faqs.q: Can the frac data van record the job for later review?
faqs.a: Yes. The multi-screen wall has recording and playback for post-job analysis, so parameters from the whole fleet can be reviewed after the job. State any data-export format you need on the RFQ.

faqs.q: Does Indus stock the trailer-mounted frac data van?
faqs.a: Yes. We list the trailer-mounted frac data van as ex-stock from our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Layout is quoted to your fleet. Send your configuration and destination through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.
